home.title: Open your home for simple and enriching encounters
home.subtitle: ... and contribute to the development of a network of trust in your area

step_1.description: In just a few minutes, I can organize a meeting at my place, setting the date and maximum number of participants.

step_2.description: I invite the contacts of my choice, possibly giving them the right to share the invitation with their own contacts.

step_3.description: At the end of the meeting, all participants have the opportunity to add the other participants to their contacts.

home.reconnexion_tagline: Facilitating the emergence of a Universal Social Network promoting encounters, mutual aid, and cooperation.
